name: claims-intake
install: cd claims-intake && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && . "$HOME/.local/bin/env" && uv sync --frozen

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd claims-intake && . "$HOME/.local/bin/env" && uv run uvicorn claims.api.routes:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
